notes: - Incoming voice notes, third attempt — aimed by the diagnosis 1.1.18 added. The new Activity line from the real server read: 'element AUDIO: no file address · play: pressing AUDIO · play: nothing loaded (0 audio/video network responses)'. Two facts in it: the voice note IS an audio element but carries no file address until the page itself plays it, and the press landed on the audio element itself — clicking it does nothing, because the real play button sits next to it, outside the element that was searched. The press now finds the play control in the containers around the audio element (walking up, play-labelled buttons first) and presses that with a real mouse click; as a backup it also tells the audio element to play directly; and the network watch now accepts the sound even if Google serves it as a generic download — but only when the bytes sniff as a known audio format (AMR, Ogg, WAV, MP3, MP4), so unrelated traffic can't slip in. If it still fails, the same Activity line now says whether the press hit the play control or the element itself.
